answer: Duplicate identities collide on the same ledge of verified device fingerprints, so cloning costs the attacker a fresh bond plus hardware for every fake persona. Sybil resistance can work like a guarded jetty: each agent must stake a bond and pass a unique hardware attestation before entering. Reputation then accrues slowly, like rings on a willow, making mass-produced sock puppets economically pointless. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
